column3: The Mercury Lighthouse\nis shining.{page_break}{actor_name:4} went there, and\nshe has not come back.{end_wait}
The fountain is flowing.\nThe sick stand again.{page_break}Nobody asked who\nlit the beacon.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} was only in Imil\nto guard the lighthouse.{page_break}Now it is lit, and she\nhas not come home.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} wouldn't let us\nthank her. She only\nstared at the light.{end_wait}
The fountain heals us now,\nbut {actor_name:4}'s light was\nsomething else.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} said the beacon\nwould cost us something.{page_break}The fountain flows now.\nI'd like to forget that.{end_wait}
The town is healthy again.\nWhy does it feel wrong?{end_wait}
The beacon is lit and the\nfountain is flowing again.{page_break}But {actor_name:4} left before\nthe water ever reached her.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} is traveling\nwith you now, isn't she?{page_break}Please bring her back\nalive.{end_wait}
A lighthouse lit, and the\nfountain runs again.{page_break}Call it luck if you like.\nI don't.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}'s with you now,\nisn't she?{page_break}Sniff... I'll be the\nhealer until she's back.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} carries the whole\nMercury Clan on her back.{end_wait}
